text: Heb. it was maruelous or hidden in the eyes of Amnon.
Heb. thin. , Heb. morning by morning.
Heb. humble me. , Leuit. 18.9. , Heb. It ought not so to be done.
Heb. set not thine heart. , Heb. and desolate.
Or, will you not, since I haue commanded you? , Heb. sonnes of valour.
Heb. according to the word of thy seruant.
Hebr. with a great weeping greatly.
